mapper.select: SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.question_text AS questionText, st.answer_text AS answerText FROM game_sessions gs INNER JOIN suspects s ON s.case_id = gs.case_id INNER JOIN questions q ON q.suspect_id = s.id INNER JOIN statements st ON st.question_id = q.id WHERE gs.id = #{sessionId} AND q.id = #{questionId}
